by its workers

lines.text: Publix only sells its stock to the people who work there.
lines.say: Publix only sells its stock to the people who work there.

lines.text: There's no stock exchange. Publix's own board sets the price, using an outside appraisal.

lines.text: Adjusted for a 2022 split, the March price went from $9.78 in 2020 to $19.65 in 2026.

lines.text: After a year with 1,000+ work hours, associates get free shares through an employee stock plan.

post.title: Publix only sells its stock to people who work there
post.ig:
Publix only sells its stock to the people who work there.

Publix stock isn't on any exchange; the board sets the price each quarter using an outside appraisal.
Split-adjusted, the March 1 price went from $9.78 in 2020 to $19.65 in 2026.
After a year with 1,000+ work hours, associates get free shares through the ESOP, which cost Publix $561M in 2025. ESOP shares were worth $13.9B at Dec 27, 2025.
Example: 100 shares at the March 2022 price ($1,376) were worth $1,965 at the March 2026 price, price only.

Sources: Publix FY2025 10-K, Publix quarterly results releases (2020-2026), Publix ESOP plan page.
News and education, not financial advice.

post.yt_desc:
Publix stock isn't traded on any exchange: it's sold only to employees and board members, and the board sets the price using an outside appraisal (Publix FY2025 10-K). Split-adjusted, the March 1 price rose from $9.78 in 2020 to $19.65 in 2026, and the ESOP, which gives eligible associates free shares, cost Publix $561M in 2025 and held shares worth $13.9B at year-end. News and education, not financial advice.
